criteria.label: Innovation & Operational Utility
criteria.reason: HealthIA demonstrates the complete Taskmaster proposition on the real deployed runtime: adaptive Gemini 3.5 + Google ADK interviewing, evidence-first multimodal ingestion, durable result/twin state, deterministic retrieval, and a completed result_explanation mission with correlated result/document evidence. The unmocked browser and one-take demo proofs show the workflow end to end rather than only through API tests, while cross-revision verification shows the outcome remains useful after process replacement.

criteria.label: Architectural Discipline & Tech Stack
criteria.reason: The candidate has evidence for every core architecture boundary: patient-scoped Firestore state, private GCS original evidence, Vertex AI through ADC, real ADK tool execution, separate build/runtime identities, fail-closed multimodal behavior, explicit billable Cloud opt-in gates, and cross-revision persistence with unchanged evidence. ADK now uses the core package while Firestore/GCS clients are declared explicitly instead of installing an unused broad GCP extras bundle. A legacy automatic deploy path discovered during the proof campaign was retired so ordinary CI cannot silently create Cloud revisions.

criteria.label: Demo & Production Readiness
criteria.reason: The repository contains a reproducible release gate, strict exact-candidate Cloud proof, full unmocked Chromium verification, cross-revision continuity, and a passing continuous judge-demo artifact that visibly covers problem, value proposition, live Gemini/ADK interaction, multimodal evidence, mission completion, relogin continuity and the Cloud Run .run.app runtime. One point remains deliberately withheld until that proven video is published at the stable judge-facing URL used by the final Devpost submission and the final submission head is locked.

critical_blockers.statement: The continuous judge demo exists and passed its Cloud/runtime/duration gates, but a stable judge-facing/public video URL has not yet been inserted into the final Devpost submission.
